integrity.method: Finite-dimensional spectral functional calculus, an absolutely convergent heat-kernel integral and uniform singular perturbation estimates.
integrity.numerical_role: Corroborating computations only; finite checks are not used to prove the universal claim.

scientific_limitations: The order is restricted to 1+epsilon with epsilon sufficiently small depending on the fixed graph.
No graph-uniform perturbation window or result for arbitrary exponents greater than one.
No exact finite-parameter closed form for the full recovery threshold beyond its root characterization.
Numerical experiments are not an infinite proof; absolute historical priority cannot be established by finitely many searches.
title: Diameter-dependent fractional-heat positivity onset on finite weighted graphs
